title: Rafael and the Gravity
author: Marguerite Eastwick
blurb: Bram Brightwater, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
